name: StoreCommandLine
scope: One startup invocation of retail 0x0048F0C0 vs the candidate symbol _StoreCommandLine in a single paired scenario (level 1, window mode, game-data working directory, same reviewed typed probe, spawn suspended before primary-thread resume).
reason: The compiled candidate entry point now calls StoreCommandLine with the real WinMain lpCmdLine and then calls StoreInstanceHandle with hInstance, reproducing the retail call site's argument and order. The sequential paired capture produced exactly one typed startup observation on each side under identical conditions, and every compared typed field is identical: the command line is the text "window level1", the return aliases the argument, is non-null and matches the stored word, the stored word aliases the argument, and the previous stored word was null on both sides. The captured candidate image (cb178c2f..., receipt 12fcd523...) validated against the current tree and the native source at capture start and after capture. This is runtime parity for the single documented startup call, not a verification-status promotion.
status_promotion: none; producing this capture does not promote a verification status. The Lead decides.

retail_call_site.name: StoreCommandLine

caller.note: Binary Ninja calls this function FX_Igimutex and gives it a wrong __stdcall prototype; radare2 names it main. The raw instruction stream and the stack offsets below are the evidence.

binary_ninja_mcp.result: exactly one caller, main 0x0048F530; one call site at 0x0048F5F4; callee range 0x0048F0C0-0x0048F0CA

radare2.result: main 0x48f5f4 CALL:--x call 0x48f0c0; main 0x48f5fa CALL:--x call 0x48f0d0

stack_offset_derivation: Prologue: sub esp,0x464 plus push ebx/ebp/esi/edi (0x10 bytes) = 0x474.
0x0048F585 mov ebp,[esp+0x478] loads hInstance; 0x0048F5EC mov ecx,[esp+0x480] loads lpCmdLine.

call_site_instructions.role: window class registered before the two stores
next start-up call after the two stores
window creation, after the two stores

result_and_use.store_command_line_return: EAX holds the same pointer (callee returns its argument); main does not read it: the next instruction pushes ebp and the next call overwrites EAX.
result_and_use.store_instance_handle_return: EAX holds hInstance; main does not read it before the next start-up call.
result_and_use.ordering: after the IGIMUTEX duplicate check and RegisterClassA; immediately before StoreInstanceHandle; before the remaining start-up setters and before CreateWindowExA.

limitations: Binary Ninja's function name FX_Igimutex and real image VA range prediction is a mis-symbolication; the call graph and instruction stream are the evidence.
The retail main was not symbolized as WinMain; lpCmdLine is identified from the WinMain ABI stack offsets, not from a symbol.
No decompiler pseudocode was used for the call ordering; the ordered instruction stream from two independent tools (Binary Ninja MCP and radare2 6.2.0) was used.

The candidate places the two stores after the IGIMUTEX check and before its own ANSI-argv conversion; retail registers the window class before these stores, while the candidate registers its class later in the scene/shell path. The two stores stay adjacent and before any window creation, matching the retail relative order that this native participates in.

establishes: Retail call-site truth: 0x0048F530 is the only caller of 0x0048F0C0. At 0x0048F5EC it loads WinMain lpCmdLine from [esp+0x480] (entry [esp+0xc]), pushes it at 0x0048F5F3, and calls 0x0048F0C0 at 0x0048F5F4. It does not read the return value. At 0x0048F5F9/0x0048F5FA it pushes the hInstance saved in EBP at 0x0048F585 and calls StoreInstanceHandle 0x0048F0D0. Both stores happen after RegisterClassA (0x0048F5E6) and before CreateWindowExA (0x0048F770).

The compiled candidate entry point reproduces that argument and order: _WinMain@16 at 0x00406B50 loads lpCmdLine from [ebp+0x10] and calls _StoreCommandLine at 0x00406BF9, then loads hInstance from [ebp+0x8] and calls _StoreInstanceHandle at 0x00406C04, before GetCommandLineW and before any window creation.

A sequential paired typed capture observed exactly one startup call on each side with identical values: command_line "window level1" (text), return aliases the argument, non-null, matches the stored word, return_text "window level1", previous stored word null, stored word "window level1" (text), stored word aliases the argument.

The captured candidate image cb178c2f... has receipt 12fcd523... that validates against the current tree and engine/src/retail/core/app_startup_natives.cpp at capture start and after capture; the image was unchanged during the capture.

Both task-owned PIDs (retail 1596, candidate 1508) were terminated and confirmed gone; no game/probe process or staged probe file remained. The foreign process observed in attempt 7 was never attached to, signalled or terminated.
